title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
按照现在国际上的金价，这保险柜里存放的十几公斤黄金就价值上百万美金。当然这对陆白来说意义不大。他并不是为了这些钱而来的，只是单纯地看上了这个保险柜存在时间久的优点，打算往里面加点料。毕竟美利坚官方和大部分吃瓜民众只要负责震惊就行了，他这个幕后黑手需要考虑的东西就多了。此时随着他意念一动，这个保险柜自动打开，陆白往里面放了一张自己用崇吾山特产赤铜打造的雨神面具。随后空气中无形的水汽浸润了保险柜内那本笔记本的墨迹。已经阴干的墨水得到水分补充，在笔记本纸张上流动起来，按照陆白的心意，重新书写起了一段全新的历史。随后这些水分再次被陆白抽出。笔记本纸张上的墨迹重新变得干燥，跟之前毫无分别。只是上面记载的文字已经变得全然不同。......而就在陆白忙活的时候，另一边，美利坚官方紧急成立的特别调查组同样没有闲着。联系宾夕法尼亚州的国民警卫队，调动适合小规模城市作战的无人机组。。。。。。为了防止上次在纽约布鲁克林大桥上那样的惨剧再次发生，这一次，在乔治.詹特利的指挥下，特别调查组内的成员各司其职，充分调动各类资源，为抓捕卢克.邓肯编织了一张密不透风的网络。从卢克.邓肯在女妖镇现身，到他跟两位表弟表妹相见，这些都在调查组的掌握之中。只是作为调查组组长的乔治.詹特利想到，女妖镇临近阿巴拉契亚山区。为了防止卢克.邓肯再一次利用复杂地形逃脱，乔治.詹特利按压住了上面要求立即动手的声音，耐心等待着。根据他这么多年来对罪犯心理的把握，像卢克.邓肯这样的人，即使得到了超出常人的能力，也不会做出对周围破坏性很大的反社会行为。他来到自己母亲出生的女妖镇，又见了自己的表弟表妹。那么下一步，很有可能就是去医院见那位脑癌晚期、昏迷不醒的琳达阿姨。调查组已经在医院附近安插了大量人手、重武器，和攻击性无人机。只要卢克.邓肯踏入其中，就像是落入蛛网的猎物一般，再难逃脱。只是事情似乎又一次出现了变化。卢克.邓肯、罗伯特还有米娜确实开车去了费城，只不过他们去的不是位于费城郊区的长老会医院，而是位于市中心的美国第一国家银行。

并且在那晃了一圈，租了个保险柜后，他们就带着几把铁锹钻进了附近的下水道。“？？？”这古怪的行为完全出乎了调查组所有人的意料。FBI那边派来调查组的助理主管威廉.斯蒂芬皱着眉头，再一次重申了自己之前提的建议。“乔治警长，我认为我们已经可以收网了，卢克.邓肯并没有如你所说的那样去位于郊区的长老会医院，我们没有必要再等待，这只会给他更多逃脱的机会。”“再等等，部署在医院附近的重火力和无人机组转移过来需要时间。”乔治.詹特利同样紧皱着眉头。“而且，如果卢克.邓肯是想为了他琳达阿姨凑齐手术费，而准备抢银行的话，这对于我们来说未尝不是一件好事。”“美国第一国家银行地下那座坚固的金库，会帮我们彻底困死这头凶兽。”“......好吧，如果你坚持的话。”觉得这番话也有点道理，威廉.斯蒂芬没有再坚持。当然，最主要的是，他觉得自己已经尽到了提醒的义务，如果到时候出了差错，是乔治.詹特利一意孤行，这锅到不了他的头上。轰隆隆！！时间在等待中一分一秒过去。在调查组部署在医院附近的人手和重火力，悄无声息转移到银行周围时，天空中响起轰隆雷声，一颗颗豆大的雨滴毫无征兆落了下来。“卢克表哥，外面好像下雨了。”在美国第一国家银行地下，下水道里，米娜看着突然升高了的污水提醒道。“下雨了正好，雨声可以掩盖掉这些声音。”卢克正在化身人型挖掘机卖力干活。对于普通人来说可能起码需要十天半个月的工程量，硬是被他那夸张的体力缩减到短短不到半天时间。看眼从下水道斜着通往银行保险库的隧道马上就要打通了，米娜拿出电话联系弟弟罗伯特。“罗伯特，你们可以行动了。”“明白。”电话那头的罗伯特声音很兴奋。因为按照米娜制定的计划，他和他几个信得过的小伙伴接下来将扮演很重要的劫匪角色，拿假枪冲进美国第一国家银行，假装抢银行，吸引那些工作人员和警察的注意力。然后卢克表哥和米娜再悄悄潜入银行保险库，把那些保险柜一一撬开，拿到雨神特拉洛克的面具以及那些白人藏在那的不义之财。再然后，他们就可以从那个挖通的隧道偷偷离开了。在离开之前，把那些假枪都留在银行里。
content_en:
According to the current international gold price, the dozen kilograms of gold stored in this safe are worth millions of dollars.Of course, this doesn't mean much to Lu Bai.He didn't come here for the money, he simply saw the advantages of this safe's longevity and planned to add some materials to it.After all, American officials and most of the people who eat melon only need to be responsible for the shock. He, the mastermind behind the scenes, has a lot to consider.At this moment, with a thought, the safe opened automatically, and Lu Bai put a Rain God mask inside that he made with red copper, a specialty of Chongwu Mountain.Then the invisible water vapor in the air soaked the ink on the notebook in the safe.The dried ink was replenished with moisture and began to flow on the notebook paper. According to Lu Bai's wishes, a new history was rewritten.Then the water was extracted by Lu Bai again.The ink on the notebook paper became dry again, no different from before.It’s just that the words recorded above have become completely different....And while Lu Bai was busy, on the other side, the special investigation team urgently established by the American government was also not idle.Contact the Pennsylvania National Guard to mobilize drone teams suitable for small-scale urban operations......In order to prevent the last tragedy on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York from happening again, this time, under the command of George Gentry, the members of the Special Investigation Team performed their duties and fully mobilized various resources to weave an airtight network for the capture of Luke Duncan.From Luke Duncan's appearance in Banshee Town to his meeting with his two cousins, everything is under the control of the investigation team.It was just that George Gentry, the leader of the investigation team, thought that Banshee Town was close to the Appalachian Mountains.In order to prevent Luke Duncan from using the complicated terrain to escape again, George Gentry suppressed the voice above asking for immediate action and waited patiently.Based on his understanding of the psychology of criminals over the years, people like Luke Duncan, even if they gain abilities beyond ordinary people, will not engage in anti-social behavior that is very destructive to those around them.He came to Banshee Town, where his mother was born, and met his cousins.Then the next step is most likely to go to the hospital to see Aunt Linda, who has terminal brain cancer and is unconscious.The investigation team has deployed a large number of manpower, heavy weapons, and attack drones near the hospital.As long as Luke Duncan steps into it, he will be like a prey caught in a spider's web, and it will be difficult to escape.But things seem to have changed again.Luke Duncan, Robert, and Mina did drive to Philadelphia, but they went not to the Presbyterian Hospital in the suburbs of Philadelphia, but to the First National Bank in the city center.

After wandering around there and renting a safe, they took a few shovels and dug into the nearby sewer."???" This weird behavior completely surprised everyone in the investigation team.William Stephen, the assistant director of the investigation team sent by the FBI, frowned and reiterated his previous suggestion."Chief George, I think we can close the net. Luke Duncan did not go to the Presbyterian Hospital in the suburbs as you said. We don't need to wait any longer. This will only give him more opportunities to escape." "Wait a little longer. It will take time for the heavy firepower and drone teams deployed near the hospital to be transferred." George Gentry also frowned."Furthermore, if Luke Duncan is planning to rob a bank because he wants to collect the surgery fee for his Aunt Linda, it might not be a bad thing for us." "The strong vault beneath the First National Bank of the United States will help us completely trap this beast." "...Okay, if you insist." Feeling that this statement made sense, William Stephen did not insist anymore.Of course, the most important thing is that he feels that he has fulfilled his obligation to remind him. If something goes wrong at that time, it will be George Gentry who insists on his own way, and the blame will not be on him.Boom!!Time passed minute by minute while waiting.When the investigation team's manpower and heavy firepower deployed near the hospital moved quietly to the area around the bank, thunder rumbled in the sky, and large raindrops fell without warning."Cousin Luke, it seems to be raining outside." In the sewer underground of the First National Bank of the United States, Mina reminded her while looking at the sudden rise in sewage."It's raining just in time. The sound of rain can cover up these sounds." Luke is working hard as a human excavator.For ordinary people, the amount of work that might take at least ten days and a half was reduced to less than half a day by his exaggerated physical strength.Seeing that the tunnel diagonally leading from the sewer to the bank vault was about to be opened, Mina took out her phone to contact her brother Robert."Robert, you can take action." "Understood." Robert's voice on the other end of the phone was very excited.Because according to the plan formulated by Mina, he and his few trusted friends will play a very important role as robbers, breaking into the First National Bank of the United States with fake guns, pretending to rob the bank, and attract the attention of the staff and the police.Then Cousin Luke and Mina quietly sneaked into the bank vault, pried open the safes one by one, and got the mask of the rain god Tlaloc and the ill-gotten gains hidden there by the white people.Then, they can sneak out through the dug tunnel.Leave those fake guns in the bank before you leave.
